scripts.tests:generate-autoloader: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/dws-framework-helpers-test-plugin composer run-script generate-autoloader
scripts.tests:run: npm run tests:start && npm run tests:generate-autoloader && npm run tests:run:integration
scripts.tests:run:integration: wp-env run tests-wordpress --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/dws-framework-helpers composer run-script tests:run:integration
scripts.tests:export-db: npm run wp-env run tests-cli wp db export wp-content/plugins/dws-framework-helpers/tests/Support/Data/dump.sql
